Hashtag.description: A node representing a hashtag used in a tweet.

Source.description: A node representing the source of a tweet.

Troll.description: A user who has posted tweets and been mentioned in tweets.

Tweet.description: A node representing a tweet, containing text, creation date, and other metadata.

URL.description: A URL that is associated with a tweet.

User.description: A user in the search system.

HAS_LINK.description: A relationship between a tweet and a URL.

HAS_TAG.description: A relationship between a tweet and a hashtag.

IN_REPLY_TO.description: A relationship between two tweets where one tweet is a reply to another.

MENTIONS.description: A relationship between a tweet and a user or troll that indicates the tweet mentions them.

POSTED.description: A relationship between a user and a tweet, indicating that the user posted the tweet.

POSTED_VIA.description: A relationship indicating that a Tweet was posted via a specific Source.

RETWEETED.description: A relationship indicating that one tweet was retweeted by another.

Source.name.description: The name of the source node.

Troll.time_zone.description: The time zone of the user.

Troll.lang.description: The language of the user's tweets.

Troll.listed_count.description: The number of users who have listed the user.

Troll.statuses_count.description: The number of tweets posted by the user.

Troll.favourites_count.description: The number of tweets the user has favorited.

Troll.followers_count.description: The number of followers the user has.

Troll.friends_count.description: The number of friends the user has.

Troll.created_at.description: The date the user was created.

Troll.id.description: The unique identifier of the user.

Troll.user_key.description: The unique identifier of the user.

Tweet.text.description: The content of the tweet as a string.

Tweet.created_at.description: The timestamp when the tweet was created.

Tweet.created_str.description: The string representation of the tweet creation date.

Tweet.id.description: The unique identifier of the tweet.

Tweet.retweeted.description: Indicates whether the tweet has been retweeted.

Tweet.retweet_count.description: The number of times the tweet has been retweeted.

Tweet.favorite_count.description: The number of times the tweet has been favorited.

URL.expanded_url.description: The full URL of the linked resource.

User.time_zone.description: The time zone of the user's location.

User.listed_count.description: The number of users who have listed this user.

User.statuses_count.description: The number of tweets posted by the user.

User.favourites_count.description: The number of tweets the user has favorited.

User.followers_count.description: The number of followers the user has.

User.friends_count.description: The number of friends the user has.

User.lang.description: The language of the user's tweets.

User.created_at.description: The date and time the user was created.

User.id.description: The unique identifier of the user.

User.user_key.description: A unique identifier for the user.
